notes: The main mega-menu JSON embedded in the homepage (same exhaustive L0/L1/L2 tree checked for Bestsellers/Clearance) has no New Arrivals nav item at any level. Grepped sitemap-categories.xml (5727 URLs) for new-arrival/new-in/just-in/whats-new/latest/new-season/newly keywords and found https://www.jaypore.com/c/new-arrivals (breadcrumb Home > Collections > New Arrivals, collection name 'New-Arrivals') plus three weaker, irrelevant matches that were opened and rejected: just-in-time-to-refresh-your-wardrobe (an apparel-wardrobe pun, not a new-arrivals listing), new-season-favorites and new-season-new-you (both apparel/lifestyle marketing collections, not new-catalogue listings). Opened /c/new-arrivals with Playwright: unfiltered it shows 2105 products mixed across Women/Men/Home Decor (GENDER facet: Home Decor (460), Men (149), Women (1496)); applied the Gender: Home Decor facet filter (fp%5B%5D=Gender__fq%3AHome+Decor), the same technique the prior Home-Decor pass used to isolate Mirror/Planter rows, and the page's own rendered header updated accordingly. This is a genuine filterable PLP -- real product grid, SORT BY/FILTER BY controls (PRODUCT, GENDER, SIZE, COLOR, MATERIAL, BRAND, OCCASION, FIT, CRAFT, PRICE, TYPE, WAISTRISE, COLLECTION facets), not an editorial/lookbook/campaign page -- confirmed by sampling the Home-Decor-filtered product titles (e.g. 'Multicolor Stainless Steel Decal Printed 3 Tier Tiffin Box', 'Golden Hand Crafted Glasses'), which are genuine newest-catalogue home-decor/kitchenware additions, not apparel mislabeled. Unlike the Bestsellers candidates, this is the single, unambiguous New Arrivals listing -- no competing synonymous slugs were found in the sitemap, so it is reported with no flag. It is reachable only via sitemap/direct link (not via the mega-menu or footer), which is normal for New Arrivals pages on many sites (commonly linked from homepage banners rather than persistent nav) and was not treated as disqualifying since the listing itself unambiguously passes the brief's genuine-listing test. Access: direct HTTPS fetch worked for HTML/robots.txt/sitemap (no block, no Claude-specific disallow); Playwright (tier 2) was required to read the exact product count and apply the Home Decor facet filter, since the live grid/count loads client-side via an internal API not visible to a plain HTTP fetch (same constraint noted in the prior Home-Decor pass). Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) was not needed.

rows.evidence: Rendered page header '‑ 461 products' after applying the Gender: Home Decor facet filter on https://www.jaypore.com/c/new-arrivals (unfiltered collection: 2105 products across Women/Men/Home Decor; the GENDER facet counter itself showed 'Home Decor (460)', the rendered header was used instead per project convention of trusting the rendered header over facet/collection-count fields).
